These observations do not establish exact invocation side effects or current policy/daemon state.

objectives.offline_test_status: Existing regression coverage exercises fixed operations and fingerprint parsing; it does not establish live SuperSU side effects.

objectives.next_engineering_action: Review the original 40E3/40E4 records and obtain new offline evidence plus independent review of side effects and recovery before considering any live proposal; owner approval alone is insufficient.
